The '''Montrol City Computer Center''' was a building in [[Montrol City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]]. It housed [[CUTH-BRT-92-X3]], a [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] that was assigned to help run the city.
